# The parts of the API no fixture app's script (api/apps/) checks, as
# `[<section>] <name>` (compat/coverage.rs says what each section holds).
# Generated by the engine's `compat` tests. The list only shrinks: a new
# API comes with a fixture whose script checks it (`covers <item>`; a case
# kept with `cargo xtask api --keep api/cases/<case>.tsx`), and
# `cargo xtask api` removes what a script checks now
# (docs/dev/compatibility.md).
